criminal_detail: Inspector Jeremy Scheublin, 45, was arrested July 10, 2026 on charges including attempted rape, sexual abuse, assault, unlawful imprisonment, forcible touching, official misconduct, and obstructing governmental administration, following a Bronx grand jury indictment. Criminal case pending as of July 2026.
incident_date_approx: December 2023 through circa 2025, while Scheublin commanded the 46th Precinct
description: A female NYPD officer assigned to the Bronx's 46th Precinct, identified in the complaint as 'N.T.', filed a civil suit on March 6, 2026 against Inspector Jeremy Scheublin, the precinct's former commanding officer. According to the complaint, Scheublin pursued an inappropriate personal relationship with her beginning when he assumed command in December 2023, made repeated unwanted advances, summoned her privately to his office, and on one occasion pinned her down and made sexually explicit remarks. The suit alleges sexual harassment and assault and a hostile work environment. On July 10, 2026, months after the suit was filed, Scheublin was arrested on a Bronx indictment charging attempted rape, sexual abuse, assault, unlawful imprisonment, forcible touching, official misconduct, and obstruction; that criminal case is pending, and the allegations in the civil suit remain unproven.
notes: Companion record to rec-61 (July 2026 harassment suit by three other 46th Precinct officers against Scheublin's successor, Deputy Inspector Juan O. Moran, arising from the same troubled-precinct scandal).
